post.description:
Provider-neutral webhook: HMAC-verified, idempotent, tenant-aware.

Business is resolved from the trusted internal payment row (via
``idempotency_key``), never from client input. Amount/currency are
verified server-side; mismatches are rejected without mutation.
Requires PAYMENT_WEBHOOK_SECRET to be configured.

Staff view: messages + bookings + tasks for a subject (scoped).

When ``phone`` and/or ``lead_id`` are supplied the timeline is filtered
to the matching subject; otherwise the most recent business-scoped

post.description:
Create a staff follow-up task from an AI/staff handoff (Prompt 7).

The summary carries ONLY caller-verified information (names, interests,
booking state already in the database) — never secrets, never another
business's data. Scoped to the staff member's own business.

get.description:
Verification PINNED to one business (two Meta apps -> two URLs).

Only ``<business_key>``'s OWN verify token is accepted here, so a Nest
verification challenge can never succeed against the Prime endpoint.

post.description:
Inbound PINNED to one business (two Meta apps -> two URLs).

The URL path (server configuration per Meta app) is the business signal;
the payload's phone_number_id is cross-checked when the business has a
configured number, and mismatches ack WITHOUT writes (no cross-tenant
records on misconfiguration). Signature is checked against ONLY that
business's app secret.

Staff outbound send using ONLY the staff member's OWN business creds.

The business comes from the server-side BusinessContext (JWT + DB
membership) — a forged ``business_id`` in the request can never select
another business's credentials.
